messages.subject: RFS r-cran-bios2cor
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I have packaged [r-cran-bios2cor] and I believe it is close for a sponsored
upload. However, some lintian warnings exist:

W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/msa/human_gpcr.fa
W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/msa/human_gpcr.msf
W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/msa/toy2_align.fa
W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/msa/toy_align.msf
W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/msa/toy_helices.txt
W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/rotamer/dynameomics_rotamers.csv
W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/rotamer/tiny_toy_coordinates.pdb
W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/rotamer/tiny_toy_dynamics.dcd
W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/rotamer/toy_coordinates.pdb
W: r-cran-bios2cor: executable-not-elf-or-script
usr/lib/R/site-library/Bios2cor/rotamer/toy_dynamics.dcd

I have never really experienced the appropriate placements of various data
files, so would it be sensible to simply lintian override these or is there an
appropriate placement for these files.

Kind regards,
Shayan Doust

[r-cran-bios2cor]: https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team/r-cran-bios2cor/

> files, so would it be sensible to simply lintian override these or is there an

Its not unusual that upstream set executable flag to files that are not
really executables.  This is catched by lintian and you can fix it in
dh_fixperms.  Just checkout my according commit.

I've uploaded the package to new.

Thanks for your work on this

    Andreas.

messages.subject: Bug#973407: transition: r-api-bioc-3.12
messages.body_plain:
Package: release.debian.org
Severity: normal
User: release.debian.org at packages.debian.org
Usertags: transition
X-Debbugs-CC: debian-r at lists.debian.org

Hi,
Bioconductor 3.12 was released 2 days ago [1]. All r-bioc-* packages
need a manual upgrade.

[1] https://www.bioconductor.org/news/bioc_3_12_release/

Please set up a tracker manually, since this is a transition of a
virtual package name.

Ben file:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
title = "r-api-bioc-3.12";
is_affected = .depends ~ /r-api-bioc/;
is_good = .depends ~ "r-api-bioc-3.12";
is_bad = .depends ~ "r-api-bioc-3.11";
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Best,
Dylan
